notes.subject: Ɲɛmɔgɔ
notes.rationale: למנצח literally 'to the one who shines/glitters from afar', i.e. the eminent one or superintendent of music.

notes.subject: משכיל
notes.rationale: A technical psalm-title term, usually rendered 'instructive poem'; kept as kalansen-donna (teaching-poem).

notes.subject: fɛ
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a preposition marker for authorship; 'by' is implied by the construct, added in Bambara.

translation: Ɲɛmɔgɔ ma, kalansen-donna, Korach (Kora) denw fɛ.
